tagline: Your first 20 hires, matched to the company you are becoming.
intro: We recruit the first twenty people at seed and Series A startups: founding engineers, first designers, first growth and ops hires. You meet a short list of people who want this stage, not a stack of resumes.
audience: Seed and Series A founders hiring across the US, remote or in Austin. Mostly software, fintech and climate teams of 3 to 40 people making their first senior hires.
pricing_note: A percentage of first-year base salary, invoiced when your hire starts. For founding roles we can take part of the fee in equity when cash is tight.

services.title: Founding engineers
services.description: Full stack, backend and infra engineers who have built from zero before and are happy owning the whole system while it is still small.

services.title: Your first designer
services.description: One product designer who can do research, flows and the marketing site, and who will set the habits the next five designers inherit.

services.title: Growth and ops hires
services.description: Your first marketer, ops lead or chief of staff, chosen for the stage you are in now rather than a title from a big company org chart.

services.title: Hiring plan sessions
services.description: A two hour working session that maps your next 20 hires, the order to make them in, and what each role should own in its first six months.

process.title: Shape the role
process.description: An hour with the founders on what this person will own, who they report to and what would make them leave. Then we write the brief together.

process.title: Meet a short list
process.description: You meet three to five people who have heard the honest pitch, hard parts included, and who still want to talk to you.

process.title: Close and start
process.description: We help with the offer, references and a first-week plan, then check in with you and your hire after their first 30 days.

proof.text: Our founding engineer came from their first shortlist.
They told candidates the hard parts before we did.
Hires four through nine, all still here.
